fields.statement: At f6dc3a5f I ran go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(headless-run-agent-tabs|run-agent-step|run-blocked|build-tabs|run-agent-tabs|arbiter-agent-tabs|review-checks-step|daemon-headless-runs)$' and it passed. headless-run-agent-tabs.txtar uses a fake rex and drives a headless run: rhiza daemon --once starts a detached rhiza run start --foreground child with REX_SESSION unset. Its -v log shows 4 rex window new calls, each with -s rhiza-repo and titled 'repo: Built · run <run id> · build · builder|verifier a|b #1'. No call contains split, so none is anchored on a driver block. The closed blocks sort equal to the opened ones (b1-b4), so each session closed only its own tab. A second --foreground run with REX_SESSION=session:mine still opened both tabs in rhiza-repo. In the diff, headlessSession (internal/api/run.go) calls ensureRepoSession on --foreground start and resume, and session.RunTabTitle names the run and step; this answers attempt 1's findings f1-f3. go test ./internal/... passed except TestGeneratedModel (internal/tui/modelapp), a read-timing check (median ~100ms, want <50ms) that fails the same way at the parent commit f2704ea1 under load average ~19. It is unrelated to this leaf.
